description: What the agent does with the text a provider streams: token and token_reset events for the task.

mutations.name: AG1
mutations.what: the agent does not hand a reset callback to the provider

mutations.name: AG2
mutations.what: a reset is announced as another kind of event

mutations.name: AG3
mutations.what: a reset does not say which task it is for

mutations.name: AG4
mutations.what: the text of an answer is not forwarded to the watchers

patches.old: onToken: (token) => { this.#emit({ type: 'token', taskId: task.id, token }); },

mutations.name: AG5
mutations.what: the pieces of text are announced as another kind of event

patches.old: onToken: (token) => { this.#emit({ type: 'token', taskId: task.id, token }); },
patches.new: onToken: (token) => { this.#emit({ type: 'text', taskId: task.id, token }); },
